title: UneceExchangedDocument
description: A collection of data for a piece of written, printed or electronic matter that is exchanged between two or more parties.

acceptanceDateTime.description: The date, time, date time, or other date time value for the acceptance of this exchanged document.

additionalId.description: An additional identifier of this exchanged document.

agentParty.description: A party representing another party for this exchanged document.

amendmentPurpose.description: An amendment purpose, expressed in text, for this exchanged document.

approverSignatoryAuthentication.description: The approver signature that authenticates this exchanged document.

attachedBinaryFile.description: A binary file attached to this exchanged document.

attachmentBinaryObject.description: A binary object that is attached or otherwise appended to this exchanged document.

buyerSignatoryAuthentication.description: The buyer signature that authenticates this exchanged document.

cancellationDateTime.description: The date, time, date time, or other date time value of a cancellation of the exchanged document.

categoryCode.description: The code specifying a category for this exchanged document.

contractualClause.description: A contractual clause of this exchanged document.

controlRequirementIndicator.description: The indication of whether or not this exchanged document has specific control requirements.

copyIndicator.description: The indication of whether or not this exchanged document is a copy.

copyIssuedQuantity.description: The number of copies issued of this exchanged document.

copyRequiredQuantity.description: The number of copies required of this exchanged document.

creationDateTime.description: The date, time, date time, or other date time value of a creation of this exchanged document.

customsId.description: A unique identifier, for customs purposes, for this exchanged document.

description.description: A textual description of this exchanged document.

disposition.description: A disposition, expressed as text, for this exchanged document.

documentResponseDocumentTypeCode.description:
A code specifying a type of response document for this exchanged document, such as a requested or required response
document type.

documentStatusCode.description: The code specifying the status of this exchanged document.

documentTypeCode.description: The code specifying the type of exchanged document.

effectiveSpecifiedPeriod.description: The specified period within which this exchanged document is effective.

electronicPresentationIndicator.description: The indication of whether or not this exchanged document is presented in an electronic format.

exchangedDocumentAmendmentPurposeCode.description: A code specifying a purpose of an amendment to this exchanged document.

exchangedDocumentResponseTypeCode.description: A code specifying a type of response requested for this exchanged document.

firstSignatoryAuthentication.description: The first or primary signature that authenticates this exchanged document.

firstVersionIssueDateTime.description: The date, time, date time or other date time value when the first version of this exchanged document was issued.

fourthSignatoryAuthentication.description:
The fourth signature, also known as the third counter signature, that has been authenticated on this exchanged document
indicating where appropriate the authentication party.

globalId.description: The unique global identifier for this exchanged document.

headerInformation.description: Header information, expressed as text, for this exchanged document.

identifier.description: The unique identifier of this exchanged document.

includedNote.description: A note included in this exchanged document.

information.description: Information, expressed as text, for this exchanged document.

issueDateTime.description: The date, time, date time or other date time value for the issuance of this exchanged document.

issueLogisticsLocation.description: The location where this exchanged document has been issued.

issuerParty.description: The party that issues this exchanged document.

itemIdentificationId.description: The unique identifier of a specific item in this exchanged document.

languageId.description: A unique identifier for a language used in this exchanged document.

lineCountNumeric.description: The count of the number of lines in this exchanged document.

lineItemQuantity.description: The number of line items in this exchanged document.

lodgementLocation.description: The location where this exchanged document has been lodged.

messageFunctionPurposeCode.description: A code specifying the purpose of this exchanged document, such as request or reminder.

name.description: A name, expressed as text, of this exchanged document.

offsetProcessingStatus.description:
A status of an offset processing, expressed as text, for this exchanged document, such as the process offsetted by this
document.

originalIssuedQuantity.description: The number of originals issued of this exchanged document.

originalRequiredQuantity.description: The number of originals required of this exchanged document.

ownerParty.description: The party that owns this exchanged document.

pageId.description: The unique identifier of a specific page of this exchanged document.

platformProviderParty.description: A platform provider party specified for this exchanged document.

previousRevisionId.description: The unique identifier of the previous revision of this exchanged document.

purpose.description: The purpose, expressed as text, of this exchanged document.

recipientAssignedId.description: A unique recipient assigned identifier for this exchanged document.

recipientTradeParty.description: A trade party that receives this exchanged document.

referenceDocument.description: Other documents referenced by this exchanged document.

rejectionResponseDateTime.description: A date, time, date time, or other date time value of a rejection response of the exchanged document.

remarks.description: A remark, expressed as text, regarding this exchanged document.

responseDateTime.description: A date, time, date time, or other date time value of a response of the exchanged document.

responseReasonCode.description: A code specifying a response reason for this exchanged document.

revisionDateTime.description: The date, time, date time or other date time value for the revision of this exchanged document.

revisionId.description: The unique identifier of the revision of this exchanged document.

secondSignatoryAuthentication.description:
The second signature, also known as the first counter signature, that has been authenticated on this exchanged document
indicating where appropriate the authentication party.

senderAssignedId.description: A unique sender assigned identifier for this exchanged document.

senderTradeParty.description: The party that sends this exchanged document.

signatoryAuthentication.description: A signatory document authentication for this exchanged document.

submissionDateTime.description:
The date, time, date time or other date time value for the formal submission of this exchanged document to a receiver by
a sender.

subtypeCode.description: The code specifying the subtype of this exchanged document.

suffixId.description: A unique suffix identifier for this exchanged document.

summaryInformation.description: Summary information, expressed as text, for this exchanged document.

thirdSignatoryAuthentication.description:
The third signature, also known as the second counter signature, that has been authenticated on this exchanged document
indicating where appropriate the authentication party.

totalPageQuantity.description: The total number of pages for this exchanged document.

traderAssignedId.description: A unique trader assigned identifier for this exchanged document.

urgency.description: An urgency, expressed as text, of this exchanged document.

urgencyCode.description: The code specifying the urgency for this exchanged document.

versionId.description: The unique identifier for the version of this exchanged document.
